texts.zh:
我们结束了对此前抓获的[contact_country.GetAdj]外星人的研究。这些人质相当不愿意同我们合作，不过由于我们已将其开膛破肚，他们的反抗毫无意义。现在我们对他们的[contact_country.GetSpeciesOrganNamePlural]、[contact_country.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural]和[contact_country.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural]的内部功能以及其他身体部分有了极大的了解，我们的基因学家[Root.GetResearchers]获得了相当有价值的异种生物学数据。

由于我们残忍行为带来的恐怖，一部分[contact_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]开始在我们翻译他们语言并接入电脑系统时表现出了合作的态度。作为结果，我们现在拥有了数量相当可观的情报，如果有需要，我们可以利用这些情报对付他们。
texts.en:
We have concluded our study of the [contact_country.GetAdj] aliens we recently captured. The hostages proved unwilling to cooperate with us, but this became a moot point as we began to cut them open. We now know a great deal about the internal functions of their [contact_country.GetSpeciesOrganNamePlural], [contact_country.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural], [contact_country.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural] and other body parts, giving our genetics [Root.GetResearchers] valuable xenobiological data.

Driven to terror by the cruelty of our actions, a handful of the [contact_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] cooperated with us as we sought to translate their language and access their computer systems. As a result, we now have considerable intelligence we are able to deploy against them, should the need arise.

texts.zh:
我们结束了对此前抓获的[contact_country.GetAdj]外星人的研究。随着两国之间通讯频道的相互公开，事实已经很明显，对方的组织结构是一个蜂巢思维，子个体没有独立行动和决策的能力。尽管审讯对他们毫无用处，但是我们对其开膛破肚，使得我们对其有了诸多方面的了解。我们现在对他们的[contact_country.GetSpeciesOrganNamePlural]、[contact_country.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural]和[contact_country.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural]的内部机能以及其他身体部分有了更多的了解，我们的基因学家[Root.GetResearchers]获得了相当有价值的异种生物学数据。

尽管花费的时间比我们原先希望的要更长，我们获得的生物学知识帮助我们破译了他们的语言——还有他们的计算机代码。若是局势需要，我们可以部署相当数量的情报来对抗他们！
texts.en:
We have concluded our study of the [contact_country.GetAdj] aliens we recently captured. As became apparent when they opened communications with us, they are indeed organized as a hive mind, with individual drones lacking autonomy or agency. Although they proved unuseful subjects for interrogation, this became a moot point as we began to cut them open. We now know much about the internal functions of their [contact_country.GetSpeciesOrganNamePlural], [contact_country.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural], [contact_country.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural] and other body parts, giving our genetics [Root.GetResearchers] valuable xenobiological data.

Though it took a bit longer than we might have hoped, the biological knowledge we gained helped us to crack their language - and their computer codes. We now possess considerable intelligence to deploy against them, should it prove necessary!

texts.zh:
我们结束了对此前抓获的[contact_country.GetAdj]机器的研究。一旦切断同人工智能主体的联系，这些无人机就失去了执行能力，无法提供与它们自己的协议相关的信息。不过当我们将它们大卸八块，我们就又获得了一定的进展——不仅是在了解它们的内部语言方面，也在找出有关它们的更多知识方面。其结论是，它们使用的处理器还是比不过我们针对它们使用的数据侵入收集技术，现在它们已经没剩下多少秘密了。

我们现在掌握了数量可观的情报，它们将被投放在合适的时机，来对付它们的人工智能主体——[contact_country.GetName]。
texts.en:
We have concluded our study of the [contact_country.GetAdj] machines we recently captured. Once cut off from their parent AI, the drones lacked agency and gave off little useful information of their own accord. Once we began dissembling them, we were able to make more progress - both in understanding their internal functioning, and in finding out more about them. It turned out their processors were no match for the invasive data gathering techniques we used on them, with the result that little about them is now secret to us.

We now possess considerable intelligence to deploy against their parent AI, the [contact_country.GetName], should we see fit.

tooltips.zh: 我们对于他们内部器官的知识可以在谍报行动中起到作用
tooltips.en: Our knowledge of their internal organs will be of use during Espionage Operations

# 外星研究完成 / Alien Study Complete
- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 首次接触：对方完成接触后的通知 reverse-contact notice
- 来源 Sources：`events/first_contact_events.txt:8096-8193` · `common/scripted_effects/first_contact_effects.txt:167-215` · `common/first_contact/00_first_contact.txt:1325-1425`
- 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（c7b-society）

## 如何开始 How it starts

当被攻击/被俘者的帝国先完成与我方的首次接触时，finish_first_contact_effect 检查我方这边仍在进行的“反向首次接触”：若其当前阶段为 default_end_stage_hostile_with_vivisection，则 30（+0–5）天后向我方发出本事件（`first_contact_effects.txt:167–215`）。/ When the victim’s empire finishes its own first contact first, finish_first_contact_effect checks our still-running reverse site; if its stage is default_end_stage_hostile_with_vivisection, this event reaches us 30 (+0–5) days later.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

**外星研究完成（1105）**：解剖研究结束；对方通话后可更好地理解解剖结果。 / Alien study complete: vivisection results interpreted once they open communications.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

单选项。效果：设置成就标记 they_come_in_pieces；机械对手 → 复制其计算机科技 50% 进度（否则工程研究加成）；有机对手 → 复制生物科技 50% 进度（否则社会研究加成）。 / Single option. Effect: sets the they_come_in_pieces flag; machine contact → copies a computing tech to 50% (else an engineering-research bonus); organic → copies a biology tech to 50% (else a society-research bonus).

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

三个文本变体取决于对方是否为普通、蜂巢、机械帝国。/ Text varies with the contact’s type.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对 Checked：脚本、finish_first_contact_effect 的反向分支、对应的敌对收尾阶段。/ Script, the reverse branch of finish_first_contact_effect and the matching hostile end stage.
- 审阅改动 Changes：无结构改动；此事件是 event-first-contact-250 篇中 290 外星研究完成（活体解剖） 的“对方先通话”版本。/ It is the “other side talked first” version of 290 外星研究完成（活体解剖） in the event-first-contact-250 story.
